description.html:
Fry in a healthier way with less or no oil. With an air Fryer, you can enjoy the same fried and crispy foods with less fat and grease.

Features & Specifications:
-State-of-the-Art Temperature Control: Our air fryer features an intuitive LCD touch screen, allowing you to set the perfect temperature with ease.
-Quick Reference Guide: No need to guess - the optimal cooking temperature and time for eight common ingredients are conveniently printed on top for your reference.
-Durable and Non-Stick Pot: Our removable pot is coated with a non-stick protective layer that is both abrasion and high-temperature resistant, ensuring easy cleaning and long-lasting performance.
-Easy Cleaning Design: The detachable fryer basket and pan are dishwasher safe, making post-meal cleanup a breeze.
-Healthy Eating Made Simple: Say goodbye to excessive oil and hello to a low-fat, low-calorie diet. Our air fryer is your partner in maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
-Powerful Performance: With a rated voltage of 220V-50HZ and a rated power of 1800W/2400W, this air fryer is built for efficiency and speed.
-Spacious Capacity: Boasting a 6L capacity, the air fryer can accommodate generous portions, perfect for families or gatherings.
-High-Quality Liner Material: The non-stick coating ensures that your food comes out perfectly cooked every time, with no sticking or residue.

Note:
-Product colors may vary slightly due to different lighting conditions and screen settings.
-Pre-set functions are tailored for Chips, Meat, Nuts, and Pizza, but you can manually adjust timing and heat for a personalized cooking experience.
-The functions and icons on the box may differ from those on the actual product.

What's in the box
1 x Air Fryer
1 x User Manual

## What does this mean?

You can pay for this item with cash when your driver delivers your order.

### How does it work?

Select Cash On Delivery (COD) as your payment option when you checkout.
Have the exact amount of cash ready for our friendly delivery driver when he arrives.

### Is COD available on every order?

No. We don’t offer COD for:

-   Digital products (e.g. eBooks, gift vouchers or airtime)
-   Customised products (e.g. a sports shirt printed with a personalised name)
-   Orders totalling less than R100 or more than R3,000
-   Orders being collected from Takealot pickup points
-   Delivery addresses falling outside of our Takealot Delivery Team area
-   Accounts that do not have a verified South African mobile number


### If your order is eligible for COD, it will be displayed as a payment option at checkout.
